I don’t have live access to the IPL’s daily fixture list, so I can’t tell you exactly who plays “today” without knowing the specific season and date.  

Here’s what you can do instead:

| Option | How it works |
|--------|--------------|
| **Official IPL App / Website** | Download the *IPL* mobile app or visit [ipl.com](https://www.iplt20.com/). Both give the full calendar, including dates, times, venues, TV links, and even push‑notifications for upcoming games. |
| **Sports News Sites** | ESPN Cricinfo, BBC Sport, Sky Sports, etc., publish weekly fixtures and highlight the next match. Search “IPL fixtures 2026” or simply “next IPL match.” |
| **Social Media & Live Updates** | Follow @IPLT20 on Twitter or Instagram – they post daily updates, start times, and behind‑the‑scenes content. |
| **Local Broadcasters** | If you’re watching via cable/satellite, most sports packages show a quick rundown of tomorrow’s cricket lineup at the top of the screen. |

If you let me know which IPL season you’re interested in (for example, “IPL 2025”, “IPL 2026”), I can point you toward the relevant page or give you a rough idea based on past patterns—though keep in mind schedules can shift due to weather, venue availability, or broadcasting needs.
